name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-05-14, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.09 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
